title: Completed demo assignments do not leak into ordinary owner follow-up turns
steps: Boot the shipped site-tools plugin, finish an assigned build turn, then stop an ordinary owner follow-up.
Exercise closed responses, Retry, same-turn steers and late old responses; compare rewritten inline punctuation against native frames.
expect: Only the active turn with a successful server answer gets build behavior; a closed demo never demands its unavailable check.
A Retry can regain assignment; old replies cannot grant or revoke the new turn. Native frame changes still fail while text punctuation remains copy.
evidence: Local owner turn8 received No check has run after completed+passed action, then AGENT_DEMO_ACTION_CLOSED. Shipped-bundle fixture before fix emitted 2 reminders instead of 1.
fence: Turn identity is captured before each await, successful server assignment is scoped to that identity, and closed refusals revoke it.

tests: a completed build does not steer an ordinary owner follow-up into its closed demo checks
a closed demo response revokes only its current-turn build behavior, and a Retry can earn it again
punctuation beside rewritten inline words is copy; its containing native frame still counts
